title: Dream Big: MongoDB Launch Experience
summary: Connecting a developer-platform story across environment, presentation, and launch creative.
overview: I directed brand and creative for MongoDB's Dream Big launch experience in San Francisco, working with technical presenters, marketing partners, and production teams to connect the product story across the environment and presentation design.
